# Implementation Plan: MCP SSE Transport Support

**Branch**: `002-mcp-sse-transport` | **Date**: 2026-01-27 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-mcp-sse-transport/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command. See `.specify/templates/commands/plan.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Add Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport support to MCP proxy, enabling proxying of Azure API Management MCP endpoints and other SSE-based MCP servers. Implement transport detection (HTTP vs SSE), SSE stream parsing, and JSON-RPC message extraction. Maintain backward compatibility with existing HTTP-only configurations.

**Technical Approach**: Use `eventsource-parser` library for SSE parsing, extend `MCPServerConfig` schema with `transport` field ("http"|"sse"|"auto"), implement auto-detection via Content-Type header, buffer SSE events until `close` event, apply existing filters/transforms to extracted JSON-RPC messages.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.x (strict mode), Node.js 20.x  
**Primary Dependencies**: Fastify 5.x, eventsource-parser 1.x, ajv 8.x, JSONata 2.x, isolated-vm 5.x  
**Storage**: N/A (configuration from JSON files only)  
**Testing**: Vitest (47 existing tests), supertest for integration tests  
**Target Platform**: Linux server (Docker), macOS (local dev)  
**Project Type**: Single project (Node.js backend service)  
**Performance Goals**: 
  - SSE parsing latency <10ms per event
  - Support 1000 req/s aggregate throughput (same as feature 001)
  - Timeout accuracy ±5% of configured value
**Constraints**: 
  - Maintain backward compatibility with feature 001 HTTP-only configs
  - SSE buffer limit: 1000 events max to prevent memory exhaustion
  - Request timeout: 1s min, 5min max (existing constraint)
**Scale/Scope**: 
  - Support mixed HTTP and SSE servers (multiple servers in one proxy instance)
  - Handle Azure APIM SSE format: `event: message\ndata: {JSON-RPC}\n\nevent: close\ndata:\n\n`
  - ~500 LOC new code (SSE parser, transport detection, config schema extension)
